core: deterministic no-solution-input logical solve without search
proof-bearing replay with dependencies and state hashes
competitor same-size exact and near-copy comparison with evidence scope

removedHardGates: minimum strategic-action count greater than one

logicalActionAPI.givensTreatment: Treat immutable givens as placed cats for completed-unit and peer-conflict proofs.
automaticHousekeeping: adjacent peer exclusions implied directly by givens or newly placed cats

openingMetrics.openingUniquePlacementCount: Distinct UNIT_SINGLE cat targets after applying givens.
openingMetrics.openingDecisionCount: Distinct non-housekeeping logical actions at the lowest available technique rank.
openingMetrics.openingTechniqueSet: Technique names among those decision actions.

dependencyGraph.construction: Build dependsOn from the proof premises returned by enumerateLogicalActions; prior actions that establish those premise facts are direct parents.
dependencyGraph.depth: Root proof depth is 1; other depth is 1 + max(parent depth); level depth is max step depth.
dependencyGraph.counterfactualUse: Removing a parent must invalidate the exact proof; use this as validation, not as the primary way to invent edges.
dependencyGraph.forbidden: Artificial previous-step chains and a separate proof implementation that can disagree with nextHint.

difficultyCalibration.poolRequirement: For every bucket, core-valid candidates must be at least demand + max(3, ceil(0.25*demand)).
difficultyCalibration.reasoningLoad: Median of the non-constant ECDF percentiles for dependencyDepth, decisionStepCount and strategicActionCount within the bucket.
difficultyCalibration.selectionRule: Technique rank remains the primary difficulty dimension. Reasoning-load percentiles only compare candidates inside the same bucket.
difficultyCalibration.fallbackPolicy: Never select outside a hard gate. If a row has zero candidates, fail preflight. Expand the pool or widen only the declared soft percentile window.

tutorialException.purpose: Friendly, explicit concept teaching rather than monotonically increasing challenge.
tutorialException.givenSelection: Enumerate solution-cell subsets of the requested size, re-run the no-solution-input analyzer, and keep only variants meeting the learning objective.

strategicActions.definition: Explicit proof-bearing cross actions excluding automatic adjacent peer cleanup.
strategicActions.hardGate: The declared target highest technique occurs at least once and no higher technique occurs.
strategicActions.countUse: Input to reasoning-load percentile and a reported diagnostic; do not require an arbitrary minimum of two.

morphology.perSizeNormalization: ECDF percentile in the core-valid candidate pool.
morphology.coarseSignature: Tertile bins of areaImbalance, meanCompactness and maxElongation; named labels are optional descriptions, not gates.
morphology.noveltyDistance: Euclidean distance across all five per-size percentile features.
morphology.selectionObjective: Maximize the minimum novelty distance to already selected same-size levels after satisfying core and difficulty gates.
packHardGates: No identical coarse signature three levels in a row.
For each size with at least 20 selected levels, every feature's selected interdecile span is at least 50% of that feature's candidate-pool interdecile span.
generatorExpansion: target-area-weighted growth for unequal region areas
directionally biased growth plus connectivity-preserving boundary mutations
morphology.referenceOnly: Reliable competitor L1-L100 geometry, excluding L39-L47, is a coverage reference and not a template or exact acceptance envelope.

globalSelection.algorithm: Preflight candidate counts, then solve the most-constrained level first with backtracking or min-cost matching plus global originality and diversity constraints.
globalSelection.forbidden: same-rank fallback or ordered[0] fallback when exactGate is empty

releaseEvidence: 10/10 tutorial learning-objective replay with declared givens
90/90 post-tutorial reasoning-load window and chapter-wave gates
morphology pack coverage report without per-level named-shape rejection
stratified human visual QA sample covering tutorial levels and morphology extremes
